programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Tha Bing ‘s Pando a’ cur nan caran air an timcheallan ‘s Bing airson ‘s gun cuir Pando mun cuairt e cho luath ‘s a ghabhas. Ged ‘s e fìor spòrs a th’ ann an toiseach, Tha Bing a’ tuigsinn nach eil e cheart cho spòrsail a bhith ro thuainealach! Bing and Pando have great fun on the roundabout and Bing wants Pando to spin him around as much and as quickly as he can! Although he loves the dizzy feeling to begin with, Bing soon realises that it’s not so fun to feel too dizzy!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Tha Bing a’ togail taigh le cluasagan, gnìomh a tha toirt air Coco geama de ‘Madadh-allaidh Mosach’ a mholadh. Tha e còrdadh ri Bing a bhith leigeil air gur e madadh-allaidh crosta a th’ ann… gus an tuig e nach fhaigh e am broinn an taigh a thog e! Bing has built a house with the sofa cushions, prompting Coco to suggest they all play ‘Big Bad Wolf’ together. Bing is very excited that he gets to be the angry wolf, until he realises that it means he won’t be allowed into the house that he built!

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: 'S e là spòrsail eile a th'ann an-diugh airson na h-Abadas agus tha iad glè thoilichte nuair a tha Ben airson cluich còmhla riutha leis a' gheama fhaclan. Dè'm facal a bhios ann agus cò a thèid air turas an-diugh: Hari an t-Each-uisge, Ela an Sionnach, neo Seren an t-Ialtag? It's another play-filled day today for the Abadas and they're delighted when Ben wants to join in and play the word game. What will the word be and who will get to go on today's adventure: Hari the Hippo, Ela the Fox or Seren the Bat?

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha stoirm le dealanaich is tàirneanaich a’ toirt luchd-tadhail chun an eilein. Tha Àtaidh is Tilidh air leth measail air na caraidean ùra aca, ach chan eil Nìp ro chinnteach. A thunderstorm brings some visitors to the island. Abney and Teal love their new friends, but Neep is not so sure.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein toilichte prìomh phàirt dealbh-chluich na sgoile fhaighinn, gus an cluinn e gur e “Bana-phrionnsa Bhàlaigh” an dealbh-chluich aca. Chan eil e airson a bhith na bhana-phrionnsa, oir ’s e nighean a tha sin! Petit is happy to be the star of the school play, until he discovers that the play they must act is 'The Brave Princess'. He doesn't want to be a princess, he's not a girl!

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachd do chlann òga. Tha Ellen NicDhòmhnaill a’ leughadh An Rìgh Leòmhann. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh is a dhealbhachadh le Emma Yarlett, agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Màiri NicCumhais. Ellen MacDonald reads An Rìgh Leòmhann, written and illustrated by Emma Yarlett and translated into Gaelic by Mairi MacCuish.

programme.title: The Deep/An Doimhne
programme.desc: Tha Stoirm Catatumbo a’ leudachadh gu luath is tha an suidheachadh a’ fàs air leth cunnartach – ach dè tha ga adhbharachadh? Feumaidh Na Neachdan seo a rannsachadh airson faighinn a-mach dè a th’ air a chùlaibh! The Catatumbo Storm is expanding rapidly and the situation is getting very dangerous, but what has caused it? The Neachdan must investigate to find out what is behind it.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Seonaidh agus a charaidean a' faireachdainn fàileadh uabhasach, saoil dè nì iad leis an tuathanach? The farmer's personal hygiene leaves much to be desired.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha na Pluic a’ ceannach ‘Grodbitan’ airson toirt orra beagan eacarsaich a dhèanamh. Chan fhada gu tuig iad gu bheil rudeigin fada ceàrr air na h-innealan, oir cha ghabh an cuir dheth às dèidh dhaibh uile an cleachdadh. Tha na Pluic ann an staing is gun dòigh aca air stad a dh’eacarsaich. Investing in GritBits to get them moving, the Spuds discover the devices are faulty and cannot be switched off once attached to their wrists. The Spuds quickly find themselves unable to stop exercising.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha Pòl a’ cuideachadh cailleach air a bheil Tilidh, is tha i a’ toirt isbean dha mar thaing. An e mac-meanmna Phòil a th’ ann, no a bheil rudeigin fortanach a’ tachairt le gach greim a ghabhas e dhen isbean? Dave helps a local old lady called Tanya, who rewards him by giving him a sausage to say thank you. Is Dave imagining it or does something lucky happen every time he takes a bite?

programme.title: Eilean Mo Ghaoil (From Lewis with Love)
programme.desc: A team of archaeologists investigate a crannog in a loch in Carloway and it’s business as usual for veteran garage owner Denis.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: The studio guest is chaplain Suzie Roberts, and Calum Maclean is in Rogart, Sutherland, seeking some relief from a sore shoulder.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Dealbhan Fraoich/Heather's Portraits
programme.desc: Islay-born Heather Dewar combines the role of artist and interviewer, creating colour portraits of well-known Gaels while teasing out of them every little detail of their life story! Heather travels to Mull where she meets Eleanor MacDougall. Eleanor was raised in Lochaber, but Mull is her grandmother’s native isle, and she moved here after graduating from art school. She is a talented silversmith who has been running her own business on the island for many years. Tha Fraoch Nic an Deòir a Ìle air ais air an sgrion le sreath ùr de “Dhealbhan Fraoich”. An dà chuid na tè-ealain agus na ceasnaiche, tha i a’dèanamh dealbhan dathte de Ghàidheil air a bheil sinn eòlach – agus a’tàladh asta iomadh sgeul mu eachdraidh am beatha. Sa phrògram seo tha Fraoch a’siubhal gu Muile far an coinnich i ri Eleanor NicDhùghaill. Ged is ann an Lochabar a rugadh sa thogadh Eleanor, bhuineadh a seanmhair do Mhuile, agus thàinig i fhèin a dh’fhuireach ann as dèidh ceumnachadh ann an sgoil nan ealan. Tha i na ceàrd-airgid air leth sgileil, aig an stiùir air a gnothachas fhèin air an eilean fad bhliadhnaichean. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Na Sgiobairean mu Dheireadh/The Last Captains
programme.desc: Series that follows determined fishermen across the fishing seasons

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc: Angus Mackay is joined by longtime friend and colleague Tormod Macleod from Carloway as they go to sea for a day’s fishing off the east coast of Lewis. Along the way they encounter sea eagles and enjoy an environment lit by the sunshine of a beautiful summer’s day. Along the way they ponder the importance of fishing on family ties. Tha Tormod MacLeòid à Càrlabhagh – deagh charaid agus co-obraiche Aonghas MhicAoidh – còmhla ris agus iad a’ dol gu muir airson latha iasgaich far costa an ear Leòdhais. Coinnichidh iad ri iolairean-mara agus a’ ghrian a’ deàrrsadh air latha samhraidh brèagha. Air an t-slighe, tha iad a’ meòrachadh air cho cudromach ’s a tha iasgach do cheanglaichean teaghlaich.

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: Tha na seann charaidean Katie agus Angela a’ stiùireadh companaidh glanaidh a bhios a’ seirbhiseachadh thaighean air mhàl geàrr-ùine gu h-àraidh. Tha an gnìomhachas air leth soirbheachail agus tha sùil aig Lewis Friseal, a tha na entrepreneur ionadail agus na chomhairliche spèiseail, anns a’ chompanaidh. Aig an aon àm, tha Betty a’ taisbeanadh bàrdachd a tha brosnaichte le peataichean agus i a’ gabhail ri call pearsanta. Le Dido a’ dèanamh air an ospadal gus leanabh a bhreith, tha Daniel a’ dèanamh beagan matamataig air leatromachd leantaileach. An dàrna sreath den sit-com fhèillmhor le Hannah McKirdy agus Lana Pheutan mar chleasaichean agus sgrìobhaichean. Old pals Katie and Angela run a cleaning company that specialises in servicing short-term lets. Business is booming and local entrepreneur and esteemed councillor Lewis Fraser has the company in his sights. Meanwhile, Betty performs pet-inspired poetry as she comes to terms with a personal loss. As Dido rushes to the hospital to give birth, Daniel does the maths on extended long-term pregnancy. Second series of the hit sitcom written by and starring Hannah McKirdy and Lana Pheutan. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Eòrpa
programme.desc: Gilleasbuig Macdonald investigates complaints about the behaviour of campervan users in Skye. Tha Gilleasbuig MacDhòmhnaill a’ rannsachadh gearainnean mu dhol-a-mach luchd bhanaichean campachaidh san Eilean Sgitheanach.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Tha Fiona NicChoinnich is Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ cur fàilt’ air The Hoosiers len ceòl beothail indie pop air Àrd-Ùrlar a’ Ghàrraidh. Dh’fhàs an còmhlan ioma-phlatinum ainmeil ann an 2007 às dèidh a’ chiad chlàr aca agus òrain a leithid ‘Goodbye Mr A’ agus ‘Worried About Ray’, agus abair gun robh taisbeanadh dòigheil aca aig Belladrum 2025. Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald welcome The Hoosiers, who bring their infectious indie pop to the Garden Stage. The multi-platinum band rose to fame in 2007 after the release of their debut album and singalong hits Goodbye Mr A and Worried About Ray.

programme.title: The Nazis: A Warning from History
programme.desc: Nearly one in five Poles died during World War II after the Nazi invasion in 1939 ushered in one of the most brutal episodes of ethnic cleansing the world has ever seen. This film destroys the myth that Poland's Nazi leaders were acting under detailed 'orders' and that the country's Nazi administration was a model of German efficiency. Arthur Greiser and Albert Forster, the two Nazi leaders charged with Germanising Poland, could not even agree on who should be Germanised. Featuring interviews with former Nazis, moving testimony from witnesses to SS atrocities in Poland, ethnic Germans and Polish Jews, the programme provides insights into how the Nazis' reign of terror in Poland was characterised by huge population upheavals, chaos, petty squabbles and sheer bloodlust.

programme.desc: 1904, England. When their father is mysteriously arrested, the Waterbury children and their mother downsize and move to the Yorkshire countryside. Bobbie, Phyllis and Peter discover the local steam railway, and on their adventures, they befriend the station porter, Mr Perks, and try to discover the truth about their father. Lionel Jeffries's beloved film version of ES Nesbit's classic book.

programme.title: Big Screen Britain: The Railway Children

The government denies it, but other people have been seeing the UFOs and having strange experiences, too. Soon, Roy is on a one-way mission to expose the truth.

programme.title: BBC Proms
programme.desc: A No 1 album and multiple Grammy wins has put singing sensation Samara Joy on the map, establishing the young American artist as ‘a legend in the making’, regularly compared to Ella Fitzgerald and Sarah Vaughan. This much-anticipated Proms debut introduces audiences to her electric combination of youthful energy and old-soul musical style with classic songs and unique twists on timeless tunes, from bossa nova to the Great American Songbook. She salutes figures including Sarah Vaughan, Ella Fitzgerald, Duke Ellington, Billie Holiday, Charles Mingus and Oscar Peterson. Andi Oliver is the guide for an evening of charisma and musical glamour.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: As governments and businesses confront their reliance on US tech giants, AI Decoded explores whether Britain can build its own AI future - and how quickly it must act. Now, a sudden decision from Washington is sending shockwaves through the global AI industry, restricting access to some of America's most advanced systems - even for its allies. For UK companies, it raises a stark question: what happens when the technology you depend on is no longer available? Presenter Marc Cieslak is joined by Yang Li of East London startup Cosine, now racing to build a 'sovereign' British alternative as demand surges following the US clampdown. Bloomberg's Katrina Manson also joins to unpack the national security stakes, alongside co-host Stephanie Hare.

programme.title: Fraud Squad
programme.desc: An accountant takes on three different full-time jobs with the NHS – and manages to get paid for all of them, even though he’s barely carrying out the work of one. Each is well paid in its own right, and he hasn’t declared that he’s working three at the same time. In fact, he’s barely working one, as he’s using the money to fund a luxury lifestyle of London hotels and extravagant days out. Investigators also discover the accountant has been taking on private clients and draining their bank accounts into his own. He’s even accused of romance fraud. In another case, undercover work exposes a benefit cheat’s lies. A woman has been claiming disability living allowance because she says she has multiple sclerosis. But after a tip-off, investigators from the Department for Work and Pensions launch a surveillance operation. She’s seen walking normally with no apparent disability. And her social media account shows a video of her on a zip wire. Investigators call her in for questioning.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: We see the culmination of an epic, six-and-a-half-year project in the West Midlands. Martel loves showing off properties in Scotland. The one she visits in Livingston may not be the finest example but it has potential. Dion is impressed by the space on offer in Leeds.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Two teams saddle up for a race around the antiques stalls at Wetherby Racecourse. Danny Sebastian is holding the reins, alongside experts Caroline Hawley and Colin Young. The reds, George and Colin, have been best friends for 36 years, while the blues are couple Lu and Tak, both education consultants. Unsurprisingly, they spot an old school desk, but does it make the grade? Colin takes a shine to a set of silver spoons with a local connection, but is the deal sweet enough? And as the clock ticks down, the reds get sidetracked by a framed letter supposedly written by King George VI. Meanwhile, the blues go potty over vases in the hope of fulfilling Danny’s challenge.

programme.desc: Spain take on Austria in Los Angeles as the 2026 FIFA World Cup round of 32 continues. Eighteen-year-old Lamine Yamal is the star attraction for Luis de la Fuente's side as they look to add the sport's biggest prize to their Euros triumph two years ago. Ralf Rangnick's Austria are hoping to back up their dramatic qualification from the group stage with what would be a seismic scalp in their first World Cup knockout game since 1982.

programme.title: Grand Tours of Scotland's Rivers
programme.desc: Paul follows the eastward course of the river South Esk from its source in the hills above Glen Clova to the extraordinary Montrose Basin, and on to the sea.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Lizzie Schofield and Brian Cunningham are starting new projects and checking on the progress of planting carried out in previous years. Lizzie is in her herb garden, which she renovated in 2024, assessing what has worked and what needs to be refreshed. Meanwhile, Brian is checking on the apple trees he planted in the spring as examples of espalier shaping and pruning. Lizzie begins plans in the garden for cut flowers that will give her foliage alongside the blooms already beginning to take shape, and Brian is planting more perennials in the terraced patio area. There are all the usual handy hints, as well as a look at what plants are good for attracting birds to your plot.

programme.title: Scotland's Greatest Escape
programme.desc: JJ Chalmers and Grado uncover the best holiday escapes in Scotland. But it’s up to friends and families from all over the country to decide which escapes make it to the grand final. In this first episode, lifelong Glaswegian friends the Karens are tasked with choosing Scotland’s Greatest Luxury Escape. They visit a secluded retreat, The Hideaway near Dundee; enjoy a private cruise aboard Argyll Cruising on the wonderful west coast; and finally visit Glenapp Castle on the Ayrshire coast. But only one escape will make it to the grand final.

programme.title: The Hunt for Peter Tobin
programme.desc: In 1991, two teenagers disappear without a trace in different parts of the UK. Fifteen years later, the murder of a woman in Glasgow reveals a terrible link between all three cases.

programme.title: The Hunt for Peter Tobin
programme.desc: With Peter Tobin accused of the brutal murder of Angelika Kluk at a church in Glasgow, detectives analyse what dark secrets might lurk in his past.

programme.title: Scot Squad
programme.desc: All access to all departments - flashing the spotlight on the good guys banging up the baddies. Knights of the road Singh and McKirdy turn firefighters to extinguish a dangerous inferno and sample some delicious sausages. City cops McLaren and Fletcher rush to the open grass in pursuit of a miscreant on a roll inside a giant hamster ball. The Chief furthers his dream of becoming a best-selling tartan noir crime writer as he rubs shoulders with one of Scotland's greatest novelists. And local man Bobby does what he believes to be the right thing when he hands in a bag of dangerous-looking weapons to officer Karen. Mirth-inducing mockumentary manoeuvres starring Jack Docherty, Manjot Sumal, Grado, Jordan Young, Sally Reid, Darren Connell, Karen Bartke and special guest Ian Rankin.

programme.title: Janey and Ashley Get a Real Job
programme.desc: Ashley and Janey try their hand at various jobs in a factory that produces everything from hand lotion to shower gel, and soap to candles. They are pushed on their ability to follow instructions and complete repetitive tasks. From restocking the on-site shop, to making soap and filling bottles, everything must be uniform and be produced at speed, with very little room for error. Trying to keep their minds from wandering, and the mess to a minimum, Ashley and Janey are put through their paces by a boss who has no time for fooling around. Janey is determined to win, but she can’t stop her creativity from taking over when she should be following a precise shop display. The question is, will it land her the ‘best employee’ trophy, or that one last job that nobody wants to do?

programme.title: Matthew Perry and the Ketamine Queen
programme.desc: Documentary investigating events leading up to the shocking death of Friends star Matthew Perry and the woman at the centre of the case, dubbed the 'Ketamine Queen' by US prosecutors. Jasveen Sangha, a drug dealer and dual US-UK citizen, has pleaded guilty to five federal charges in Los Angeles, including one count of distributing ketamine resulting in death or bodily injury. She faces up to 65 years in prison for supplying Perry with the drugs that led to his death. Sangha was one of five people charged in the case. Prosecutors described her home as a 'drug-selling emporium', where authorities found approximately 79 vials of ketamine and other drugs, including methamphetamine, cocaine and Xanax. Presented by Amber Haque, the film features exclusive, first-on-the-record interviews with Sangha's friends and examines her role in Perry’s death and Hollywood’s ketamine drug network.

programme.title: The TikTok Effect
programme.desc: What connects amateur sleuths turning up at crime scenes, anti-social behaviour in UK schools and riots in France? The answer, according to a BBC investigation, is that they are all examples of a TikTok 'frenzy'. Marianna Spring, the BBC’s disinformation correspondent, has spent the last year investigating harmful behaviour on TikTok spilling out into the real-world. She tracks down users, victims and former employees to expose how extremely high engagement on TikTok around some topics appears to be creating these 'frenzies' linked to behaviour previously seen as unacceptable.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: The wildlife action moves to the south coast of Australia as naturalist Steve Backshall and the Deadly 60 team take the plunge in the waters of the Pacific. Steve has heard that yellowfin tuna are super-fast lethal killers, but what makes them so special? He witnesses their missile-like streamlined bodies for himself and is left in no doubt as to their turbo-charged credentials when he dives with over a thousand of them. He then tests his own body's streamlined capabilities, with hilarious results. Strange alien-like giant cuttlefish also await Steve in the warm Pacific waters. It is then a short hop up the coast to try and track down perhaps one of the weirdest animals on Steve's list, the elusive duck-billed platypus.

He then tests his own body's streamlined capabilities, with hilarious results. Strange alien-like giant cuttlefish also await Steve in the warm Pacific waters. It is then a short hop up the coast to try and track down perhaps one of the weirdest animals on Steve's list, the elusive duck-billed platypus.

programme.title: EastEnders
programme.desc: Bea’s behaviour leaves Honey concerned. Cindy clashes with Zoe over business rivalry. Walford celebrates Pride.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May set out to buy second-hand convertibles and discover some of the unusual pitfalls to watch out for when picking up a used car bargain. Jeremy is on the test track in the powerful Pagani Zonda R, whilst Simon Pegg is the Star in a Reasonably Priced Car.

programme.title: The Traitors US
programme.desc: A bloody banquet shakes the whole castle. Traitor trust teeters, and a gamer takes on a housewife. The mission means a trek to the epic Fyrish Monument, where one player will win a great power. Alliances are tested at the Round Table.

programme.title: The Traitors US
programme.desc: While the temperature rises between the Traitors, a strategic murder shakes the castle, alliances are tested, and a heated conversation makes for a simmering Round Table. One player has an impossible decision to make.

programme.title: Blink Twice
programme.desc: When tech billionaire Slater King meets cocktail waitress Frida at his fundraising gala, sparks fly. He invites her to join him and his friends on a dream vacation on his private island. Wild nights blend into sun-soaked days, and everyone is having a great time. No-one wants this trip to end, but as strange things start to happen, Frida begins to question what is real and what is not. There is something wrong with this place. She will have to uncover the truth if she wants to make it out of this party alive.

programme.title: Top Gear

programme.title: Do You Know Your Place?
programme.desc: The competition steps up a gear as presenter Owain Wyn Evans, Olympic champion Greg Rutherford and Blue Peter’s Abby Cook return for day two of the quiz. programme.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
programme.desc: Officers attending a call to a house where a woman has been punched in the face are confronted by a man with a large knife. There is a tense stand-off before they are able to cuff and arrest him. Stephen challenges a man arrested for a hate-motivated crime close to Belfast city centre. There are comical scenes as the Peelers try to herd cattle through the busy streets of west Belfast. Back in the city centre, Dave and Owen come across a group of drug users openly injecting cocaine in broad daylight, in a public square. As they arrive, they find one man still injecting. A tense stand-off ensues, and police describe how they have to deal with the drug abuse and homelessness crisis. Elsewhere, officers are called to reports of a street fight between two women. While the police are trying to establish order amid the chaos, one woman wrestles with them, biting Anna and spitting blood into Tom and Adam’s eyes. She’s taken into custody wearing a spit and bite guard. Stephen looks on as the visibly distressed woman is processed through the police system. He is deeply affected by what he sees and hears – the reality of frontline policing.

programme.title: Two Weeks in August
programme.desc: The group have been kicked out of the villa, and Zoe’s disappearance prompts a frantic search. Nat’s co-dependency with Jacob is challenged when unexpected guests trigger an awkward run-in with the local police. Unable to face up to her actions, Zoe is on a dangerous quest for answers. What is her connection to this island? Can she ever go back to who she was? And even if she could, is it more important to be happy or good?

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty is in full summer mode - revamping and refreshing borders to keep the garden looking its best right through the season. He turns his attention to the cucurbit family, planting melons and squash, shares a simple trick to extend the flowering of hardy geraniums, and sows perennial seeds for spectacular colour next year. Arit Anderson heads to south east London to discover the striking transformation of a garden that was once a derelict space into a bold, contemporary community garden powered by creativity, collaboration and clever planting. Rachel de Thame explores how self-seeding plants can be carefully choreographed to create a beautifully natural, flowing design. There’s a passionate grower dedicated to the National Collection of penstemons, and in the Yorkshire Dales, a florist and lifelong gardener shares a deeply personal story of resilience - finding strength, purpose and renewed creativity through rebuilding a garden after a life-changing diagnosis.

programme.desc: Sir Jeffrey Donaldson – the secret sex abuser who used faith and fidelity as a mask. programme.title: Murder Trial
programme.desc: The remains of a body are discovered in an abandoned warehouse in Scotland, but the victim, the motive and the cause of death are all unknown. Soon, a shocking and premeditated crime is uncovered as decorator David Barnes stands accused of killing his customer - but nobody knows how he died. In a unique criminal case shrouded in mystery, this programme follows the family’s quest for justice and goes behind the scenes at the Scottish High Court.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos watch a carpenter who is working in her garden. They see her pulling out a tape measure to measure a piece of wood, which they find very interesting. While she goes to fetch her toolbox, the Twirlywoos take the end of the tape measure and pull it out all the way across the garden, where they hide in a bush just as the carpenter returns. A tug of war ensues between the Twirlywoos and the carpenter. Suddenly the Hooter summons the Twirlywoos home, just as the carpenter gives a really big pull, and she falls back in surprise! Back in the boat, Peekaboo is trying to pull a long vine out of the hole in the wall when the Twirlywoos return. As Peekaboo rushes back into the hole, the vine is left outside. The Twirlywoos are curious about the vine, and they pull on the end of it. Peekaboo responds by pulling the other end back through the hole, and it turns into a tug of war. Eventually the Twirlywoos pull so hard that Peekaboo is pulled out of the hiding place and goes flying over their heads!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin has lots of outdoor summer fun with his friends. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble judges the Best Kept Garden competition - will the award go to Aunt Polly or Grandad Tumble?

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. They enjoy going on the Tubby Bouncy, the Tubby Uppy Downy, the Tubby Spinny and the Tubby Slidey.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Pip, Theo, Lola, Oakley, Tommy and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their little ones at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside Nigel’s bag are a duck sponge and stacking toy boats, and all the parents and babies have different objects and toys that could be used as part of a bathtime routine. These are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby-appropriate bathtime objects and toys inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun children’s song Splishy, Splashy In The Bath features, as does a story involving Baby Bear, and viewers at home show what they have been doing at bath time too. The Together Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with sensory bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children balance buckets of water through an obstacle course, learn British Sign Language signs for up, water and fell down, then sing and sign Jack and Jill.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: James, Noah and Aaron are on a mission to tidy up the city centre garden for a party. They work alongside Chatterpot’s friends - a rake, a spade and Wheely the wheelbarrow.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Zawadi and Njamba the rhinos set out to explore the wild with their friend Bahati the zebra. Hamza finds a coypu and sets up a camera trap with Ranger Godfrey.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: A volcanic eruption nearby leads Sweet Potatodons to Lava Land, which upsets savoury kin.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey forgets to put her favourite toy away, cousin Socks grabs it and won’t let go! The kids stage a horsey wedding to distract her, with Dad and Uncle Stripe as the horses!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Green is surprised when Black and White arrive in her forest. Learn about light and dark colours with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Anya finds out all about some colourful teeny tiny creatures – dragonflies. Chantelle goes fossil hunting before meeting British Dragonfly Ambassador and Blue Peter young gardener, George. Meanwhile, Rory and his son Sandy are searching the skies and ponds for dragonflies. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files explain how fast dragonflies are, where they have babies and how their extraordinary eyes work. It’s also time to find out what dragonflies tell us about the environment and the role they have in the food web. And this episode’s Teeny Tiny Task is to go pond dipping.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ted and his family head to the harbour and have fun trying to catch crabs. Will the crustacean critters be tempted by the bacon bait? Back home, Ted helps Dad clean Mum’s car, and then they make delicious spaghetti and meatballs for the whole family.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Cassava cake is a very popular dessert in the Philippines, so Reese is making a very special version for her friends to try when they come to visit. Reese's family come from the Philippines, and this recipe is a family favourite. This is a cake that has lots of savoury ingredients, such as cheddar cheese and cassava, but also includes sweet flavours such as condensed milk and coconut cream. Cassava is a root vegetable and tastes very different when it is eaten on its own, so Reese is hoping her friends will like the taste of it when they taste it in her cake. She's even preparing some delicious fruit to serve alongside it.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today's episode, Maddie is cleaning up. She visits a factory where hand wash is made and uses her special camera to see inside a big vat to see the colour being mixed. Next, Maddie visits an appliance testing centre to find out how a vacuum cleaner works. She takes apart a vacuum cleaner to show us all the different parts and, using her special camera, show us how air gets sucked up through the machine so the filter can collect all the dirt and dust from our carpet!

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Kika is a golden labrador and a guide dog for her owner, Dr Amit, who is blind, which means he cannot see. She is trained to use her supersight to help Dr Amit do as many things as he can by himself. Together, they make the best team! Dr Amit has a very important letter to post. But first, he and Kika need to buy a stamp at the shop in time to catch the last post. Dr Amit checks his braille watch, which has little raised bumps to help him tell the time, while Kika dodges an enormous barrel outside the shop to help them find the door. Inside, Kika finds her way to the counter, only to be given an important lesson about queueing by a very helpful handbag. Kika helps Dr Amit buy his stamp and guides him to the postbox. But they’re too late! They’ve missed the post. Now they must race across town to find another postbox and track down Pete the postman. Will Dr Amit get his letter sent on time?

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar meet one of the zoo’s noisiest residents, Arthur the sea lion. He shows them his amazing teeth and flippers and then jumps in the water to demonstrate his incredible swimming skills. Next, they visit the biggest rodent in the world, the capybara. Steve and Aneeshwar give them their breakfast and reveal the wild connection between these two very different animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Evie, Doug, Jess and Gramps take Waffle to his first puppy training class. Waffle can't resist causing chaos. Simon stays at home to look for his missing sock.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona and Baba get stuck on the cliff during a storm.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Stripes has big ideas about how to transform the Sunhouse into a bigger, more popular music venue. When his plans don’t go down well with the rest of the garden gang, Stripes must learn that their garden and stage are perfect just as they are!

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie, Triggs and Dad are making a special cake for Granny. Dad is extremely careful about following the recipe, but Maddie has a slightly looser approach. Okay, a lot looser… Will their new bonkers cake pass the Granny test?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: After the Squirrels tell Duggee that they are feeling sleepy, he insists that some exercise will wake them right up. So together, they set off on a warm-up run. Along the way, they meet characters who are exercising too, and in turn, they learn new and fun ways to work out. They practice their royal waving skills with King Tiger and test out Ethel’s jungle playground – exercise can be fun too! Chew Chew teaches them flexibility and endurance as they all move in rhythm with one another. The Squirrels are amazed by the positive benefits of exercise and understand that it gives you energy, clears your mind and makes your spirit soar – all at the same time.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Seven shows the others how to be lucky: ask a number friend to jump on your head! But how do you know which friend? Find out how to tell the difference between two numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: It's bedtime for A, E, I, O and U, but vowels will be vowels and there's no getting them to snuggle down. L's lullaby usually does the trick, but she needs a little help from her friends. This episode introduces the letter L and the words log, lid, bed, ted, hug, cot, nap and lips.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble pretends to be a doctor, while Justin and his friends imagine that they are pirates.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. The Teletubbies eat tubby custard and ride the Tubby Custard Ride around Home Dome. A child in Tummy Tales tries to make his baby sister laugh.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 65 million years to the time of Tyrannosaurus rex - Andy's favourite dinosaur of all time. It also had a pretty impressive roar which Hatty has simulated in the museum using the trumpet of an elephant and the bark of a dog. When the CD of the sound effect gets damaged moments before the museum opens, Andy vows to fix the problem. His mission is to track down a T rex and record its massive roar - but that will mean getting up close and personal with one of the biggest known meat eaters on the planet. Will he succeed and will he make it back to the museum in time?

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s Stall. She chooses the monster finger puppet and remembers the day she got it. When Mack gets a delivery of new toys, they remind him of the fun he and Molly used to have with finger puppets when they were younger. Alice has always wondered what it would be like to have a sibling. Mack thinks back and realises that things don’t always go to plan when Molly’s around, but then, he sometimes has a habit of messing things up too. He tells Alice he knows he can always rely on Molly to help him out, even if it means he has to share Daisy with her too. Alice thinks Molly and Mack have a special relationship. Molly arrives and agrees. She couldn’t ask for a better big brother!

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing tractor machines! Grace gets behind the wheel of an eight-wheeled tractor, shows off a two-way tractor and then test drives a methane tractor.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster worries about showing people his favourite conch shell when everyone else has unicorn-themed items for their show-and-tell presentations.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Kwazii finds that the 'dragon' he’s met is really a Gila monster.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Mr Tod is trapped in Mr McGregor's garden, Peter reluctantly agrees to help him escape but soon learns that you should never trust a fox!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: After watching the birds fly above them, the Squirrels discover that birds can also slide, run and lay eggs. This encourages them to learn more about the natural environment, and they discover how to do this responsibly with Duggee’s five easy steps: watch carefully, stay at a distance, don’t interfere, be patient and alert, and stay quiet. The Squirrels embark on their own individual discoveries outside in rivers, the sea, mountains, the jungle and the desert. They learn how to spot an animal’s disguise, better known as its camouflage. They see how birds may try to impress one another, which is in stark contrast to how a horned lizard uses its body to warn other creatures off. A fascinating look at nature!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When Popcorn accidentally breaks the x-ray machine, he does everything he can to fix it before Vida finds out, but all he needs to do is ask for help. When he finally does, Vida knows just what to do and assures Popcorn he’s still the best vet tech ever.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato is out chasing a milkshake robot and leaves Broccoli in charge of Tato Tower. Evil Pea tries to take over the tower, but Broccoli puts on a great defence.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy and the Ducklings find a chest full of circus supplies. When the cheeky Chipmunk puts on his own show, Weasy trains the Ducklings to do an incredible circus act that will impress the whole farm!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Preston needs Mojo and Bo to pull his big balloon to a place where he can snap a picture of a rare bird. But his balloon gets loose, and Mojo and Bo need to get Preston back on the ground.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey’s bedtime story is disturbed by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In a game of hairdressers, Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Twiggy has a funny tummy on the day of his performance. Nothing the doctors try works, not even the cure for froggy moths! Zog wonders if there is something else bothering Twiggy.

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: The Fantastics playfully sack Georgie. Jaz is appointed as the team’s new coach but finds it harder than she thought. Georgie tries her hand at other jobs - with chaotic results.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi, Dash and Jake set off on a camping adventure, determined to stick to their wizarding scout plan - no wishes allowed! When they realise the original plan won’t work, Rafi suggests making a new one instead. With teamwork, flexibility and the right wish, the Wizard Wagon takes flight and carries them to the perfect camping spot at sunset. Rafi learns that plans can change, and sometimes the best adventures come from making a new one together.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo is having a summer sleepover at Gran Gran's house and has brought everything she needs from home, including her favourite bedtime storybook. But JoJo is confused when Gran Gran suggests it might be bed-time, even though the sun is still shining in the sky! JoJo wanted to see the twinkly sleepover stars before she slept, just like the ones on the cover of her storybook. Gran Gran resolves to use fairy lights to create their own night time starry sky, and JoJo learns that the sun stays in the sky longer during summer.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. The Ribbon Sisters invite Sarah and Duck to their favourite seasonal event in the park.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: A Skymoo accidentally knocks the Iron Chicken out of her nest, and in falling to the surface of the Clangers' planet she hurts her wing. But although Major Clanger manages to mend it, she has lost her confidence and can't fly. It takes all the ingenuity of Small Clanger, and another intervention by the Skymoo, to get her back to her nest under her own wing power.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: BaBa falls down whilst dancing, so MeMo gives BaBa a hug to feel better. At Play Time, they play with a teddy bear, which is really nice to hug. When Yellow Yummy trips, MeMo and BaBa hug Yellow Yummy to help them feel better. MeMo hugs BaBa as they drift across the Lullaby Lake on their way to meet Gramma Leeba in the Bay of Books for a story about their day.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Series for young children about a magical place inhabited by a community of toy characters that care for each other and have fun together. Everyone in the Night Garden boards the Pinky Ponk for a special journey to see a magical flower.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Join Gaz Coombes as he tells the story of Meesha, a girl who loves to make things but finds it tricky making friends.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s Carrot performing a superstylish song - if he manages to make up his mind and pick an outfit.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Sula collect acorns in the park with Flop. When Bing's pile of acorns keeps getting smaller, Flop shows him where to hide behind a bush to see what's happening to them - a squirrel is the culprit, hiding acorns for winter.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: In Tummy Tales, a boy learns to knit with purple wool and in Teletubbyland, purple Tinky Winky answers the Tubby Phone and leads the Tubby Phone Dance. Tinky Winky also plays with the Tiddlytubbies.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: Explore the amazing world around us with baby monkey Tee and his Mum, Mo. Sing along, join in with stories and get ready for some family fun!

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: The Colourblocks discover that it can be fun to colour things wrong. Learn about choosing colours with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Coco want to read Charlie a story. Bing wants to read Biteysaurus's Big Book of Dinosaurs, and Coco wants to read The Rainbow Fairy Mice and the Disappointed Dragon. Bing's book is first, but when Coco tries to bring the Rainbow Fairy Mice into the story, Bing is frustrated – that's not how it goes! But Flop shows Bing how they can combine the two tales together.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Nori and Preston are creating a circle of standing stones, just like the ancients of Swoppiton used to make. The stones are big - will it take more than Mojo’s crane top to move them?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It’s Duggee’s diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren’t sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey’s bedtime story is disturbed by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In a game of hairdressers, Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are adventure-seeking explorers who soar around the planet fixing environmental problems caused by Grandmaster Glitch!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Benjamin and Cotton-tail become lost in the Shadowy Woods during a game of peekaboo. Can Peter use this very same game to help them elude a prowling Mr Tod?

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. A sea sponge that houses other sea creatures in its pores suffers from a mysterious illness, and Peso must figure out the cause.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Rocket Ten and friends blast off into space for a rhyming adventure to visit planets 11 to 20. Explore numbers 11 to 20 with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. B the bassist and her brother D the drummer get new guitarist N to join the band, but they still need a singer. They try auditioning the vowels but make some strange sounds before the band is complete.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The shadow of a monster causes panic among the Piris, apart from Nugget, who is keen to investigate a new mystery. She finally tracks down the creature, but is all exactly as it seems?

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun pretending to be frogs, and Kingsley and Queenie have a froggy fiesta. In Boxtropolis, Sketch splats a picture of a lily pad fit for a frog.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing is at Amma's creche when a butterfly flies in and lands on Sula's painting. Bing tries to help the butterfly go back outside by picking it up, but he holds it too tightly and the poor butterfly is squished. Flop and Amma help the sad children say goodbye to the butterfly.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘unicorn’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different types of unicorn – white, rainbow, sparkly, fluffy and a yummy unicorn. Dee has a ride on a flying unicorn and dances with a friend and a disco unicorn! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu gets upset when she loses Declan's special toy.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri is upset when she finds some strangers sitting on Rockaroonie.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: Ziff, Pipp and Button don their spacesuits to become the first frogs to walk on the moon.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos watch a carpenter who is working in her garden. They see her pulling out a tape measure to measure a piece of wood, which they find very interesting. While she goes to fetch her toolbox, the Twirlywoos take the end of the tape measure and pull it out all the way across the garden, where they hide in a bush just as the carpenter returns. A tug of war ensues between the Twirlywoos and the carpenter. Suddenly the Hooter summons the Twirlywoos home, just as the carpenter gives a really big pull, and she falls back in surprise! Back in the boat, Peekaboo is trying to pull a long vine out of the hole in the wall when the Twirlywoos return. As Peekaboo rushes back into the hole, the vine is left outside. The Twirlywoos are curious about the vine, and they pull on the end of it. Peekaboo responds by pulling the other end back through the hole, and it turns into a tug of war. Eventually the Twirlywoos pull so hard that Peekaboo is pulled out of the hiding place and goes flying over their heads!

programme.desc: Seven shows the others how to be lucky: ask a number friend to jump on your head! But how do you know which friend? Find out how to tell the difference between two numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: It's bedtime for A, E, I, O and U, but vowels will be vowels and there's no getting them to snuggle down. L's lullaby usually does the trick, but she needs a little help from her friends. This episode introduces the letter L and the words log, lid, bed, ted, hug, cot, nap and lips.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble pretends to be a doctor, while Justin and his friends imagine that they are pirates.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. The Teletubbies eat tubby custard and ride the Tubby Custard Ride around Home Dome. A child in Tummy Tales tries to make his baby sister laugh.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 65 million years to the time of Tyrannosaurus rex - Andy's favourite dinosaur of all time. It also had a pretty impressive roar which Hatty has simulated in the museum using the trumpet of an elephant and the bark of a dog. When the CD of the sound effect gets damaged moments before the museum opens, Andy vows to fix the problem. His mission is to track down a T rex and record its massive roar - but that will mean getting up close and personal with one of the biggest known meat eaters on the planet. Will he succeed and will he make it back to the museum in time?

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s Stall. She chooses the monster finger puppet and remembers the day she got it. When Mack gets a delivery of new toys, they remind him of the fun he and Molly used to have with finger puppets when they were younger. Alice has always wondered what it would be like to have a sibling. Mack thinks back and realises that things don’t always go to plan when Molly’s around, but then, he sometimes has a habit of messing things up too. He tells Alice he knows he can always rely on Molly to help him out, even if it means he has to share Daisy with her too. Alice thinks Molly and Mack have a special relationship. Molly arrives and agrees. She couldn’t ask for a better big brother!

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing tractor machines! Grace gets behind the wheel of an eight-wheeled tractor, shows off a two-way tractor and then test drives a methane tractor.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster worries about showing people his favourite conch shell when everyone else has unicorn-themed items for their show-and-tell presentations.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Kwazii finds that the 'dragon' he’s met is really a Gila monster.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Mr Tod is trapped in Mr McGregor's garden, Peter reluctantly agrees to help him escape but soon learns that you should never trust a fox!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: After watching the birds fly above them, the Squirrels discover that birds can also slide, run and lay eggs. This encourages them to learn more about the natural environment, and they discover how to do this responsibly with Duggee’s five easy steps: watch carefully, stay at a distance, don’t interfere, be patient and alert, and stay quiet. The Squirrels embark on their own individual discoveries outside in rivers, the sea, mountains, the jungle and the desert. They learn how to spot an animal’s disguise, better known as its camouflage. They see how birds may try to impress one another, which is in stark contrast to how a horned lizard uses its body to warn other creatures off. A fascinating look at nature!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When Popcorn accidentally breaks the x-ray machine, he does everything he can to fix it before Vida finds out, but all he needs to do is ask for help. When he finally does, Vida knows just what to do and assures Popcorn he’s still the best vet tech ever.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato is out chasing a milkshake robot and leaves Broccoli in charge of Tato Tower. Evil Pea tries to take over the tower, but Broccoli puts on a great defence.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy and the Ducklings find a chest full of circus supplies. When the cheeky Chipmunk puts on his own show, Weasy trains the Ducklings to do an incredible circus act that will impress the whole farm!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Preston needs Mojo and Bo to pull his big balloon to a place where he can snap a picture of a rare bird. But his balloon gets loose, and Mojo and Bo need to get Preston back on the ground.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey’s bedtime story is disturbed by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In a game of hairdressers, Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Twiggy has a funny tummy on the day of his performance. Nothing the doctors try works, not even the cure for froggy moths! Zog wonders if there is something else bothering Twiggy.

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: The Fantastics playfully sack Georgie. Jaz is appointed as the team’s new coach but finds it harder than she thought. Georgie tries her hand at other jobs - with chaotic results.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi, Dash and Jake set off on a camping adventure, determined to stick to their wizarding scout plan - no wishes allowed! When they realise the original plan won’t work, Rafi suggests making a new one instead. With teamwork, flexibility and the right wish, the Wizard Wagon takes flight and carries them to the perfect camping spot at sunset. Rafi learns that plans can change, and sometimes the best adventures come from making a new one together.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo is having a summer sleepover at Gran Gran's house and has brought everything she needs from home, including her favourite bedtime storybook. But JoJo is confused when Gran Gran suggests it might be bed-time, even though the sun is still shining in the sky! JoJo wanted to see the twinkly sleepover stars before she slept, just like the ones on the cover of her storybook. Gran Gran resolves to use fairy lights to create their own night time starry sky, and JoJo learns that the sun stays in the sky longer during summer.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. The Ribbon Sisters invite Sarah and Duck to their favourite seasonal event in the park.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: A Skymoo accidentally knocks the Iron Chicken out of her nest, and in falling to the surface of the Clangers' planet she hurts her wing. But although Major Clanger manages to mend it, she has lost her confidence and can't fly. It takes all the ingenuity of Small Clanger, and another intervention by the Skymoo, to get her back to her nest under her own wing power.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: BaBa falls down whilst dancing, so MeMo gives BaBa a hug to feel better. At Play Time, they play with a teddy bear, which is really nice to hug. When Yellow Yummy trips, MeMo and BaBa hug Yellow Yummy to help them feel better. MeMo hugs BaBa as they drift across the Lullaby Lake on their way to meet Gramma Leeba in the Bay of Books for a story about their day.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Series for young children about a magical place inhabited by a community of toy characters that care for each other and have fun together. Everyone in the Night Garden boards the Pinky Ponk for a special journey to see a magical flower.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Join Gaz Coombes as he tells the story of Meesha, a girl who loves to make things but finds it tricky making friends.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: In this special episode, we follow the stories of two men born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. In our first case, Arthur Fitzharris was born in Ireland in 1947 and had a happy childhood raised by adoptive parents - after they passed away, he decided to find out about his birth family and was dismayed to discover that his birth certificate falsely recorded early foster parents as though they were his biological parents. In our second case, Bernard McGrath was born in Ireland in 1953 - it wasn't until he was 40 that he heard it rumoured that he was adopted and, confronting his mother, she confirmed it was so. This bombshell was closely followed by another - his adoptive parents were falsely named as his biological parents on his birth certificate and no other records seemed available to him - so Bernard began a decade-long search for the truth.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: In this special episode, we follow the stories of two men born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. In our first case, Arthur Fitzharris was born in Ireland in 1947 and had a happy childhood raised by adoptive parents - after they passed away, he decided to find out about his birth family and was dismayed to discover that his birth certificate falsely recorded early foster parents as though they were his biological parents. In our second case, Bernard McGrath was born in Ireland in 1953 - it wasn't until he was 40 that he heard it rumoured that he was adopted and, confronting his mother, she confirmed it was so. This bombshell was closely followed by another - his adoptive parents were falsely named as his biological parents on his birth certificate and no other records seemed available to him - so Bernard began a decade-long search for the truth.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: In this special episode, we follow the stories of two men born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. In our first case, Arthur Fitzharris was born in Ireland in 1947 and had a happy childhood raised by adoptive parents - after they passed away, he decided to find out about his birth family and was dismayed to discover that his birth certificate falsely recorded early foster parents as though they were his biological parents. In our second case, Bernard McGrath was born in Ireland in 1953 - it wasn't until he was 40 that he heard it rumoured that he was adopted and, confronting his mother, she confirmed it was so. This bombshell was closely followed by another - his adoptive parents were falsely named as his biological parents on his birth certificate and no other records seemed available to him - so Bernard began a decade-long search for the truth.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: In this special episode, we follow the stories of two men born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. In our first case, Arthur Fitzharris was born in Ireland in 1947 and had a happy childhood raised by adoptive parents - after they passed away, he decided to find out about his birth family and was dismayed to discover that his birth certificate falsely recorded early foster parents as though they were his biological parents. In our second case, Bernard McGrath was born in Ireland in 1953 - it wasn't until he was 40 that he heard it rumoured that he was adopted and, confronting his mother, she confirmed it was so. This bombshell was closely followed by another - his adoptive parents were falsely named as his biological parents on his birth certificate and no other records seemed available to him - so Bernard began a decade-long search for the truth.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: In this special episode, we follow the stories of two men born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. In our first case, Arthur Fitzharris was born in Ireland in 1947 and had a happy childhood raised by adoptive parents - after they passed away, he decided to find out about his birth family and was dismayed to discover that his birth certificate falsely recorded early foster parents as though they were his biological parents. In our second case, Bernard McGrath was born in Ireland in 1953 - it wasn't until he was 40 that he heard it rumoured that he was adopted and, confronting his mother, she confirmed it was so. This bombshell was closely followed by another - his adoptive parents were falsely named as his biological parents on his birth certificate and no other records seemed available to him - so Bernard began a decade-long search for the truth.

programme.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught On Camera
programme.desc: More jaw-dropping footage filmed by members of the public while those behind the fascinating stories share their memories of these once-in-a-lifetime experiences - from the heart-stopping moment a plane stalls in mid-air while skydivers are clinging to the outside to the dramatic moment that a British skier fights for her life in an avalanche, this programme is filled with incredible life-changing events that are all captured on camera.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: In this special episode, we follow the stories of two men born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. In our first case, Arthur Fitzharris was born in Ireland in 1947 and had a happy childhood raised by adoptive parents - after they passed away, he decided to find out about his birth family and was dismayed to discover that his birth certificate falsely recorded early foster parents as though they were his biological parents. In our second case, Bernard McGrath was born in Ireland in 1953 - it wasn't until he was 40 that he heard it rumoured that he was adopted and, confronting his mother, she confirmed it was so. This bombshell was closely followed by another - his adoptive parents were falsely named as his biological parents on his birth certificate and no other records seemed available to him - so Bernard began a decade-long search for the truth.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: In this special episode, we follow the stories of two men born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. In our first case, Arthur Fitzharris was born in Ireland in 1947 and had a happy childhood raised by adoptive parents - after they passed away, he decided to find out about his birth family and was dismayed to discover that his birth certificate falsely recorded early foster parents as though they were his biological parents. In our second case, Bernard McGrath was born in Ireland in 1953 - it wasn't until he was 40 that he heard it rumoured that he was adopted and, confronting his mother, she confirmed it was so. This bombshell was closely followed by another - his adoptive parents were falsely named as his biological parents on his birth certificate and no other records seemed available to him - so Bernard began a decade-long search for the truth.
